payload.name: Capture explicit offers of help or tips
payload.description: During extraction, when a participant explicitly offers assistance, tips, support, or future help to another participant, create a memory recording the offer and its topic.
content: If a message contains an explicit offer by one participant to provide help, tips, support, or future assistance to another, extract a memory capturing that offer.
Record the offering participant, recipient, topic, and the nature of the offer (e.g., support or tips) as an event or relationship memory.
Do not require a completed past action; a stated willingness or availability is sufficient.
Ensure the offer is supported by the message wording and avoid adding details not present.

solves: Construction pipelines often skip explicit offers of assistance, tips, or future help because the utterance is phrased as a conditional offer rather than a factual statement or preference. This causes missing memories about support commitments. The rule applies whenever extraction processes dialogue where one participant explicitly offers help, tips, or support on a topic to another participant.
